notes.title: Demo Hits This October!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Drone Arsenal demo!
Set for release in October 2025, the demo offers a vertical slice of the game, showcasing core mechanics, gameplay, and the potential of the full version. Wishlist the demo on Steam to get access right at launch!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640593/30a685d6fe0613a824f4169e1c9d14f5569c57bc.png"]
What’s Included in the Demo
Vertical Slice of Gameplay: Experience the core of the game—from drone control to tactical battles.

Campaign: 3 levels with increasing difficulty, showcasing story progression and mechanics.

Arsenal: 3 drone types with unique abilities and 10 weapon varieties, including prototypes from the full version.


Why You Should Try It
- The demo is a complete slice of the game, giving you a clear sense of what Drone Arsenal is about.

- Your demo progress won’t carry over to the main game, so feel free to experiment freely!

- Your feedback on Steam will help us refine the game before launch.


How to Get Access
1. Visit the Drone Arsenal demo page on Steam.

2. Click “Add to Wishlist” to secure access to the demo in October 2025.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640593/5fc29f6c51384fd08d8635b1feb2f21a703b5b59.png"]
